The claims all concern AAPL, and `alter_existing_thesis` returned no change. Claim c3 states a forward figure with a metric (foldable iPhone units), a period (Dec quarter), a value (low-single-digit millions) and a unit (units), so `revise_projections` applies to AAPL with that claim. Claim c2 gives only a percentage trim with no unit-bearing value, and c4 is opinion, so I'll pass c3 alone. A possible `spawn_new_thesis` call for the foldable debate remains available on a later turn.
